card.statement:
Given a $X^{\bullet}(T)$ -graded (not necessarily commutative) algebra $A$ and a choice of a cocharacter $\sigma\in X_{\bullet}(T)$ , the $B$ -algebra of $A$ is

(2.18)

$B(A)=A_{0}/\sum_{\langle\sigma,\lambda\rangle>0}A_{\lambda}A_{-\lambda}.$

In the commutative case, where $A$ is the coordinate ring of an affine variety with a $T$ -action, the $0$ -weight part corresponds to the coordinate ring of the orbit space (affine GIT quotient). Quotienting out by $A_{\lambda}A_{-\lambda}$ removes the non-trivial orbits in the orbit space, so that $\mathrm{Spec}B(A)$ is the (scheme-theoretic) fixed locus. As $X\to Y$ is the affinization map, we know that $\mathcal{O}(X)=\mathcal{O}(Y)$ as commutative algebras. Therefore, Conjecture 2.30 can be restated as the isomorphism

(2.19)

$B(\mathcal{O}(X))\cong H^{*}(X^{!};k).$

The equivariant Hikita conjecture (the Hikita–Nakajima conjecture, cf. [KTW+19, Conjecture 8.9]) extends the Hikita conjecture to a conjectural isomorphism between the $B$ -algebra of the universal quantization $\mathcal{A}$ of $\mathcal{O}(X)$ and the equivariant cohomology of $X^{!}$ :
card.label: Definition 2.31

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
